acceptance.output_evidence:
READINGS RECORDED, NO VERDICT OFFERED.

ON THE TWO FOLDS, why they are not symmetric in the text:
(a) PRD s.3 @99cc431075 row 1 is the single ratified class 'Fixed Income / Cash' -- ONE class whose name carries both served words. So 'Cash' -> 'Fixed Income' is not a fold ACROSS classes at all; it is two served names of one class arriving at that class's row. The served payload keeps them as separate keys (cash, fixed_income) and every read site sums them.
(b) s.3 row 2 is 'Equity', annotated in the PRD's own table cell as 'equities only -- volatility and hedge REMOVED to Structured'. So 'Hedge' -> 'Equity' folds ACROSS two ratified classes, in the direction the PRD explicitly removes. On that reading the asymmetry is the PRD's, not the cell's.
(c) THE READING THAT CUTS THE OTHER WAY, recorded because it is the one a grader should test: the same file documents that the Cash fold was added because an unmapped class rendered NOWHERE while still counting toward the grand total (PFDE 90 served rows -> 89 rendered). Dropping the Hedge fold restores exactly that shape for a top-level 'Hedge' -- it is now unmapped, so ASSET_CLASS_ORDER's filter excludes it silently. The cell's premise is that R1 leaves no such value; I measured that premise and it HOLDS TODAY (asset_class histogram over the 110 served holdings: {'Fixed Income': 59, 'Equity': 51}, zero 'Hedge'), but it is a premise about the producer, not a property of the page. Filed as W22-S12.
(d) A THIRD READING NOT TAKEN: re-point 'Hedge' -> 'Structured' rather than dropping it. Andrew's ~19:5xZ word ('all volatility/options/overlay etc assets will be grouped into there, regardless if its a Fixed Income or an Equity Hedge or etc') would support it. The cell says DROP, so DROP is what is implemented; re-pointing would be satisfying the cell by another route.

ON THE PRE-B1 ZERO ROWS:
(e) WHAT A READER SEES TODAY, measured: Structured, Commodities and Alternatives each render a row with the value 0 on every book, in both modes, painted in that class's colour. The subtotals still sum to 100 (Models: 100.00 on all five books; ETFs: 100.00, 100.00, 99.99, 99.99), so the page is internally consistent -- a reader adding the visible rows gets the total.
(f) THE AMBIGUITY, stated plainly: a 0 in this page's vocabulary means 'this book holds none of it'. Between the deploy and B1's retag it will ALSO be produced by 'the producer does not emit this key yet', and those two are not distinguishable at the render.
